text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? My skin's breaking out...! Wait, 
why!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even though I was so careful with both my 
diet and how I washed my face...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
In that case... maybe the facial wash is 
to blame. It felt good afterwards, though. 
Guess it just didn't suit me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"And I was being so careful all along, 
too. Ugh, this is so frustrating!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel seems to be troubled by 
rough skin...
